description: The positions heard from one vessel over a time range, oldest first, with speed, course, and navigational status. Positions implying an impossible speed for the vessel are left out. Use for where a ship was yesterday, when it left port, or its route today. Anonymous and personal calls reach the last 48 hours; feeder and commercial tokens reach further, 7 days per call. By default the positions are spread evenly over the range; interval_minutes sets the spacing.

from.description: start, RFC 3339 UTC; default 24 hours before to. Anonymous and personal calls reach back 48 hours; feeder and commercial tokens reach the archive, up to 7 days per call

interval_minutes.description: at most one position per this many minutes; by default the limit is spread over the range at a round spacing, reported as interval_s

limit.description: positions to return: default 50, maximum 200; when more match, the newest are kept

mmsi.description: the vessel's MMSI; use search_vessels_by_name first when you only have a name

name: get_vessel_track

attribution.description: credit line per source kind in the positions, to show with the data

from.description: start of the range covered, after clamping to what the caller can reach: the last 48 hours, or the archive for feeder and commercial tokens

interval_s.description: at most one position per this many seconds; 0 is every position heard

seen.description: time of the report, RFC 3339 UTC

truncated.description: true when more positions matched than were returned; the newest were kept, so set from later or raise interval_minutes

title: Where a vessel has been
